failure_summary.description: Filter-only follow-ups triggered fresh base searches instead of retrieving compatible cached results and applying the new filters.
Search results were not assigned and saved correctly, including saving an undefined variable or the search function itself.
The agent searched hotels without required stay dates and inferred proximity from a hotel request alongside an independent attraction request.
The attraction category was changed to a near-synonym and a state abbreviation was passed as a city.

patch.reasoning: The skill already directly specifies cache retrieval and filtering, assign-then-save result handling, mandatory hotel-date checks, avoiding inferred proximity, and exact attraction-type and state-field mapping. These trajectories show violations of existing guidance rather than an uncovered skill gap, so additional edits would duplicate it.
